conviction_note: The weak August and off-premise scanner data were made public by the CEO on 2026-09-08, eight days after the quarter closed, and the stock fell about 5% that day. At the same conference the CFO said results were in line with the April guide, so the main downside event the 15.75-point put skew is paying for (a guide cut) has largely been ruled out by the company itself. Against that, reaffirm-only quarters on this name have paid -1.6% and +1.0%, and FY27 consensus of $11.81 sits near the top of the $11.20-11.90 range. That leaves p_up at 53 on a 5.2% absolute move, so the scaled number is +0.31. The findings sum to +0.20; the two numbers agree in sign and are both close to zero.
bar: Q2 FY27 comparable EPS $3.61-3.62 and revenue $2.54-2.57B, from two agreeing estimate sources: Zacks via Yahoo 2026-10-01 (EPS $3.62, revenue $2.57B, beer net sales $2.43B (+3.8%), beer operating income $958.6M; https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/countdown-constellation-brands-stz-q2-121502130.html) and Investing.com 2026-10-06 (EPS $3.61, revenue $2.54B; https://in.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/constellation-brands-faces-earnings-test-as-beer-demand-wavers-93CH-5620745). FY27 bar: company guide of comparable EPS $11.20-11.90 and beer net sales -1% to +1%, reaffirmed 2026-06-30 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/16918/000001691826000028/stzex991_53120268kearnings.htm); FY27 consensus EPS $11.81 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/constellation-brands-q2-2027-earnings-123315947.html).
positioning_check: Short interest 8,516,727 shares, 5.68% of float, 3.4 days to cover at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 4.2% on the prior period (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/STZ/short-interest/). That is not crowded, so a squeeze is not a mechanism here. The baseline skew is +15.75 vol points (25d put minus 25d call), which means downside protection is heavily bid. Put/call open interest is 0.75. Spot is 2.6% above the 52-week low and 30.6% below the high, 20-day run-up is -4.35%, and 5-day is +2.62%. The stock fell about 13.5% from 2026-08-31, and price targets were cut by Evercore, TD Cowen, JPMorgan (to $133), BNP (to $110) and Bernstein in mid to late September. Consensus EPS moved only -0.4% in 30 days, though, so the multiple was reset rather than the earnings bar.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-08, eight days after Q2 closed on 08-31 and with the quarter's numbers known, CFO Hankinson said at the Barclays conference that the company 'remains aligned with the full-year guidance it provided in April'. At the same conference a year earlier (2025-09-02) the company cut its guide by 8-K. This year no mid-quarter 8-K was filed: the only 8-Ks since July are a note redemption and a refinancing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide changes move this name: the April 2026 FY27 guide gave +8.53%, and the September 2025 mid-quarter cut gave -6.6% (an 8-K, not a print). Reaffirm-only prints did less: July 2026 (beat plus reaffirm) -1.59%, October 2025 +1.03%.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew is +15.75 and price targets were cut through late September, so the option market is still paying for a downside event, and a guide cut is the obvious one. If the market had taken in a post-quarter reaffirmation from the CFO, the put skew would be closer to this name's normal level and the stock would not be 2.6% off its low. The weak-August half of the same remarks is what the tape absorbed (-5% on the day).
findings.independence: The EDGAR 8-K list shows no Item 2.02 or 7.01 guidance update since 2026-06-30; the 2026-09-08 8-K is a note redemption and the 2026-09-18 8-K is a debt agreement (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000016918&type=8-K). The prior-year cut by 8-K is in the baseline (2025-09-02 row). Caveat applied: consensus of $11.81 sits near the top of the range, so a narrowing toward the midpoint inside 'aligned' is still possible, and that shrank this finding.

findings.finding: NielsenIQ off-premise data show Constellation weakening through the quarter: dollars -1.3% and -561.1K cases in the 4 weeks to 2026-07-18, -2.2% and -799K cases in the 4 weeks to 08-15, and -1.7% and -717K cases in the 4 weeks to 09-05, while the beer category fell 4.7% in dollars and 5.9% in volume. Modelo and Corona were still declining.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Depletion weakness was sold when it came with a guide cut (September 2025 -6.6%, January 2025 -17.1%), and was looked through when the guide held (July 2026: depletions -0.3%, stock -1.59%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. The CEO called August 'pretty lackluster' on 09-08 and the stock fell about 5% to a 52-week low (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/constellation-brands-stock-falls-to-52-week-low-after-cautious-ceo/70080374). What may not be priced is the gap between this roughly -3 to -4% off-premise volume and the 'flat depletions' some previews carry. If that gap were priced, consensus EPS would have come down by more than the 0.4% it has moved.
findings.independence: Same NIQ series for the earlier periods: https://www.foodbusinessmea.com/u-s-beer-sales-slows-as-summer-momentum-fades-nielseniq/ (2026-08-01, 4 weeks to 07-18). This is a proxy: it covers off-premise only, and management says on-premise was strong with World Cup share gains (MarketBeat 2026-09-13).

findings.finding: The year-ago comparison is a distributor destock: in Q2 FY26 beer shipments fell 8.7% to 117.4M cases while depletions fell only 2.7%. In Q1 FY27 shipments rose 1.8% against depletions of -0.3%. Shipments can therefore grow in Q2 even if depletions are negative, which supports beer net sales against the +3.8% consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue and EPS beats with reaffirmed guidance were not rewarded: July 2026 -1.59% after a roughly $0.23 EPS beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Consensus beer net sales of +3.8% already builds in an easy comparison. Any edge is the size of the destock (about 6 points of volume) against consensus shipment growth of about 2%, and that rests on my own inference, not on a company shipment guide.
findings.independence: Q1 FY27 shipments +1.8% versus depletions -0.3%: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/16918/000001691826000028/stzex991_53120268kearnings.htm. Shares the company's own reporting with no outside confirmation.

findings.finding: On the Q1 call management said beer marketing would exceed 10% of net sales in Q2 and Q3 (World Cup, NFL). That pressures the seasonally highest-margin quarter; consensus beer operating income of $958.6M on $2.43B implies about 39.4%, against 40.6% a year ago.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY26 beer margin fell 200bp on COGS, tariffs and marketing; the stock rose 1.03% on that print.
findings.why_not_priced: It sits inside the guided FY27 beer margin of 37-38% and inside a consensus that already models a lower margin. If it were mispriced, consensus beer operating income would sit above last year's percentage margin, and it does not.

findings.finding: The customs value of Mexican beer exports fell 5% year on year to $3.221B in H1 2026 (January-June; GCMA). Mexico shipped 93.3% of that value to the US. June is the first month of Constellation's Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a broad proxy: value only, with no volumes, no split by exporter and no FX adjustment. Over overlapping months it is contradicted in direction by the company's own number (Q1 FY27 shipments +1.8%), so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: None. The company's own shipment number points the other way.

findings.finding: Between 2026-09-21 and 09-28 at least five brokers cut price targets (Evercore $175 to $160, TD Cowen $174 to $150, JPMorgan $165 to $133, BNP $115 to $110, Bernstein $197 to $180), and the stock fell 13.5% from 08-31 to near its 52-week low. Over the same 30 days consensus EPS moved only -0.4%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After large drawdowns into a print the stock has rallied when the guide held: April 2026 +8.53%, January 2026 +5.32%.
findings.why_not_priced: Sentiment has been reset, but earnings estimates have not, so a print that merely meets the bar has less to overcome than the price action suggests. The flat EPS revisions are also a caveat: the bar did not come down, which is why this finding is small.
findings.independence: Zacks estimate revision of -0.4% over 30 days: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/countdown-constellation-brands-stz-q2-121502130.html

outside_window.finding: On 2026-07-21 the Teamsters formally asked USTR for tariffs of up to 75% on Mexican beer (Modelo, Corona, Tecate) within the USMCA joint review, with review rounds running in September. No decision is dated inside the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Q1 FY27 10-Q and earnings exhibit: no Q2 shipment-phasing statement; repurchases of 1.47M shares in Q1 and $100M after quarter end, which is routine

EDGAR 8-Ks since 2026-06-30: 07-24 (AGM/officer), 09-08 (redemption of the $600M 4.35% 2027 notes), 09-18 (debt agreement and refinancing). Financing is routine refinancing with no distress, so neither filed
INEGI August trade-balance bulletin (oportuna, July data): no beer line in the summary tables
Beer Institute monthly import data for July and August 2026: brewbound 403 and no dated 2026 snippet
Bev Bytes / Goldman distributor survey for Labor Day 2026: not found
Section 232 aluminum and Midwest premium changes since July 2026: nothing new beyond the 50% tariff already in the guide
Hispanic consumer and immigration-enforcement read-through for Q2: only 2025 coverage, nothing new and dated

rejected_candidates.detail: The company's Q1 FY27 release and Zacks both show comparable EPS of $3.43 beating consensus; the article is unreliable machine-written copy

rejected_candidates.detail: No enacted measure, date or primary source is given; the only dated tariff item is the Teamsters petition, which is filed in outside_window

baseline_tension: The finding with the most weight (a post-quarter reaffirmation) cuts against the heavy put skew and the negative 20-day run-up, and the scanner finding agrees with them. The positive lean therefore rests on the company having already disclosed the bad half of the quarter on 09-08. That, and this name's flat reactions to reaffirm-only prints, keep p_up at 53 rather than higher.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 7: the guidance-reaffirmation finding runs against a +15.75 skew, and this name paid -1.6% and +1.0% for reaffirm-only prints, so it went from +0.8 to +0.5 and p_up from 55 to 53. The explicit reason the skew may be wrong (the CFO spoke after quarter end) is kept.
Lesson 3: the price-target-cut positioning finding argued against itself (EPS estimates down only 0.4%), so it went from +0.3 to +0.1.

Lesson 5: the NIQ off-premise proxy is partly offset by the company's on-premise and World Cup comments and was largely priced on 09-08, so it went from -0.5 to -0.4. The Mexican export-value proxy is contradicted in direction by the company's own Q1 shipments, so it went from -0.1 to -0.05.

Lesson 6: the marketing-spend margin item sits inside the guided 37-38% beer margin, so it went from -0.3 to -0.15. The easy-comparison inference went from +0.3 to +0.2 because consensus already models it. The bar was verified from two agreeing sources (EPS $3.61/$3.62).
Core step 3b: abs_move_pct went from 5.0 to 5.2 because of the repo's documented understatement (slope 0.72-0.76). The Teamsters tariff petition stays in outside_window.
